songs.title: I Saw Three Ships
songs.body:
[Verse 1]
I [G]saw three ships come sailing in
On Christmas Day, on [D]Christmas Day
I [G]saw three ships come sailing in
On Christmas [D]Day in the [G]morning

[Verse 2]
And [G]what was in those ships all three
On Christmas Day, on [D]Christmas Day
And [G]what was in those ships all three
On Christmas [D]Day in the [G]morning

[Verse 3]
Our [G]Savior Christ and His lady
On Christmas Day, on [D]Christmas Day
Our [G]Savior Christ and His lady
On Christmas [D]Day in the [G]morning

[Verse 4]
Pray, [G]whither sailed those ships all three
On Christmas Day, on [D]Christmas Day
Pray, [G]whither sailed those ships all three
On Christmas [D]Day in the [G]morning

[Verse 5]
O, [G]they sailed into Bethlehem
On Christmas Day, on [D]Christmas Day
O, [G]they sailed into Bethlehem
On Christmas [D]Day in the [G]morning

songs.title: We Three Kings
songs.source: John Henry Hopkins Jr., 1857 (public domain); original chart
songs.body:
[Verse 1]
[Em]We three kings of [B7]Orient [Em]are
Bearing gifts we traverse a[B7]far
[Em]Field and fountain, [D]moor and mountain
[Am]Following [B7]yonder [Em]star

[Chorus]
O [D]star of wonder, [G]star of [D]night
[G]Star with royal [D]beauty bright
[Em]Westward [D]leading, [C]still pro[D]ceeding
[G]Guide us to thy [D]perfect [G]light

[Verse 2]
[Em]Born a king on [B7]Bethlehem's [Em]plain
Gold I bring to crown Him a[B7]gain
[Em]King forever, [D]ceasing never
[Am]Over us [B7]all to [Em]reign

[Verse 3]
[Em]Frankincense to [B7]offer have [Em]I
Incense owns a Deity [B7]nigh
[Em]Prayer and praising, [D]all men raising
[Am]Worship Him, [B7]God on [Em]high

songs.title: Good King Wenceslas
songs.body:
[Verse 1]
Good King [G]Wenceslas looked out
On the feast of [D]Stephen
When the [G]snow lay round about
Deep and crisp and [D]e[G]ven
Brightly shone the moon that night
Though the frost was [D]cruel
When a [C]poor man came in [G]sight
Gathering winter [D]fu[G]el

[Verse 2]
Hither, [G]page, and stand by me
If thou know'st it [D]telling
Yonder [G]peasant, who is he
Where and what his [D]dwel[G]ling
Sire, he lives a good league hence
Underneath the [D]mountain
Right a[C]gainst the forest [G]fence
By Saint Agnes' [D]foun[G]tain

[Verse 3]
Bring me [G]flesh and bring me wine
Bring me pine logs [D]hither
Thou and [G]I will see him dine
When we bear them [D]thi[G]ther
Page and monarch, forth they went
Forth they went to[D]gether
Through the [C]rude wind's wild la[G]ment
And the bitter [D]wea[G]ther

songs.title: Coventry Carol
songs.body:
[Verse 1]
[Em]Lully, lullay, thou little tiny [B7]child
By by, lully, lul[Em]lay
Lully, lullay, thou little tiny [B7]child
By by, lully, lul[Em]lay

[Verse 2]
O [Em]sisters too, how may we do
For to preserve this [B7]day
This poor youngling for whom we do sing
By by, lully, lul[Em]lay

[Verse 3]
Herod the [Em]king, in his raging
Charged he hath this [B7]day
His men of might, in his own sight
All young children to [Em]slay

[Verse 4]
That [Em]woe is me, poor child, for thee
And ever mourn and [B7]say
For thy parting neither say nor sing
By by, lully, lul[Em]lay

songs.title: Here We Come A-Wassailing
songs.body:
[Verse 1]
Here we [G]come a-wassailing among the leaves so [D]green
Here we [G]come a-wandering so [C]fair to be [D]seen

[Chorus]
Love and [G]joy come to you
And to [C]you your wassail [G]too
And God bless you and send you a [C]happy New [G]Year
And God [C]send you a [D]happy New [G]Year

[Verse 2]
Our [G]wassail cup is made of the rosemary [D]tree
And so [G]is your beer of the [C]best bar[D]ley

[Verse 3]
We are [G]not daily beggars that beg from door to [D]door
But we are [G]neighbors' children whom you have [C]seen be[D]fore

[Verse 4]
God [G]bless the master of this house, likewise the mistress [D]too
And all the [G]little children that round the [C]table [D]go

songs.title: Rio Grande
songs.body:
[Verse 1]
Oh, [C]say was you ever in Rio Grande
[G]Away, you Rio
Oh, [C]say was you ever on that strand
For we're bound for the [G]Rio [C]Grande

[Chorus]
And a[C]way, you Rio
[G]Away, you Rio
Sing [C]fare you well, my bonny young girl
For we're bound for the [G]Rio [C]Grande

[Verse 2]
So it's [C]pack up your donkey and get under way
[G]Away, you Rio
The [C]girls we are leaving will get our half-pay
For we're bound for the [G]Rio [C]Grande

[Verse 3]
We've a [C]jolly good ship and a jolly good crew
[G]Away, you Rio
A [C]jolly good mate and a good skipper too
For we're bound for the [G]Rio [C]Grande

songs.title: What Shall We Do with a Drunken Sailor
songs.body:
[Verse 1]
[Em]What shall we do with a drunken sailor
[D]What shall we do with a drunken sailor
[Em]What shall we do with a drunken sailor
[D]Early [Em]in the morning

[Chorus]
[Em]Hooray and up she rises
[D]Hooray and up she rises
[Em]Hooray and up she rises
[D]Early [Em]in the morning

[Verse 2]
[Em]Put him in the long-boat till he's sober
[D]Put him in the long-boat till he's sober
[Em]Put him in the long-boat till he's sober
[D]Early [Em]in the morning

[Chorus]
[Em]Hooray and up she rises
[D]Hooray and up she rises
[Em]Hooray and up she rises
[D]Early [Em]in the morning

[Verse 3]
[Em]Put him in the scuppers with a hosepipe on him
[D]Put him in the scuppers with a hosepipe on him
[Em]Put him in the scuppers with a hosepipe on him
[D]Early [Em]in the morning

[Verse 4]
[Em]Shave his belly with a rusty razor
[D]Shave his belly with a rusty razor
[Em]Shave his belly with a rusty razor
[D]Early [Em]in the morning
